articles.title_en: What happens in vagueness
articles.title_cn: 模糊性中发生了什么
articles.abstract_en: Why do people speak vaguely when they propose illicit deals? We examine the strategic use of vague speech. Participants play an economic game in which a schemer and accomplice can coordinate to take money from a mark. When a cop was watching, the schemer was more likely to send a vague message (“Some things are better left unsaid”) to the accomplice, which usually recruited the accomplice to collude. In Experiment 2, the schemer could write their own message. When the cop was watching, they wrote messages that were more vague, which again recruited the accomplice effectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么人们在提出非法交易时会说话含糊其辞？我们研究了模糊言语的策略性使用。参与者玩一个经济游戏，其中策划者和同谋可以协调从目标那里取钱。当有警察在监视时，策划者更可能向同谋发送模糊信息（“有些事情最好不说”），这通常能招募同谋进行勾结。在实验2中，策划者可以自己写信息。当警察在监视时，他们写的信息更加模糊，这再次有效地招募了同谋。

articles.title_en: Inequality’s ripple effect: Analyzing its influence on the natural interest rate and monetary policy in Germany, Japan, and the US
articles.title_cn: 不平等的连锁反应：分析其对德国、日本和美国自然利率和货币政策的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes how different forms of inequality have affected potential growth and the natural interest rate in the U.S., Germany, and Japan during the last two decades. Growing inequalities may constitute a drawback for the recovery of these economies after the Great Recession (GR) and the Covid-19 pandemic. To this aim, we modify the semi-structural model proposed by Holston, Laubach and Williams (2017) by considering the effects of several inequalities. We jointly estimate potential growth and the natural interest rates, showing that the latter can substantially modify the time path of the real interest rate, which prevails when economies are at full strength and inflation is stable. Finally, we study the effects of our estimates on the reaction functions of the monetary authorities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了过去二十年中不同形式的不平等如何影响美国、德国和日本的潜在增长和自然利率。日益严重的不平等可能会对这些经济体在大衰退（GR）和新冠疫情19大流行之后的复苏构成阻碍。为此，我们通过考虑几个不等式的影响来修改 Holston、Laubach 和 Williams (2017) 提出的半结构模型。我们共同估计了潜在增长和自然利率，表明后者可以大幅改变实际利率的时间路径，而实际利率在经济完全强劲且通胀稳定时普遍存在。最后，我们研究了我们的估计对货币当局反应函数的影响。

articles.title_en: Quality innovation, cost innovation, exporting, and firm productivity evolution: Evidence from the Chinese electronics industry
articles.title_cn: 质量创新、成本创新、出口与企业生产率演化：来自中国电子行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes the role of innovation in firm productivity evolution, distinguishing between quality-improving and cost-reducing innovations. Using a dynamic structural model estimated with data from the Chinese electronics industry, we find that quality innovation, while more costly, boosts domestic revenue, whereas cost innovation better supports export performance. Our counterfactual analysis shows that firms are most responsive to fixed-cost subsidies for cost innovation and exporting. However, when a fixed-budget constraint is introduced, the effectiveness of the quality innovation subsidy catches up with the other two. We also find that small and inexperienced firms tend to respond by exporting, while large and experienced firms are more likely to respond by innovating.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了创新在企业生产率演化中的作用，区分了质量改进型创新和成本降低型创新。利用基于中国电子行业数据估计的动态结构模型，我们发现质量创新虽然成本更高，但能提升国内收入，而成本创新则更能支持出口绩效。我们的反事实分析表明，企业对成本创新和出口的固定成本补贴反应最为敏感。然而，当引入固定预算约束时，质量创新补贴的有效性赶上了其他两者。我们还发现，小型且缺乏经验的企业倾向于通过出口来应对，而大型且有经验的企业则更可能通过创新来应对。

articles.title_en: Heat impacts college student grades even in rich Singapore
articles.title_cn: 即使在富裕的新加坡，高温也会影响大学生的成绩
articles.abstract_en: The rich city-state of Singapore has invested heavily to adapt to its current tropical climate. We access all student-level undergraduate course records between 2005 and 2019 at one of its leading universities and find that even here, fluctuations in heat impact human capital formation. An in-sample shift in de-seasoned weather from the coolest to the hottest semester reduces semester-long performance by 1.5%. Using quasi-random variation, we find evidence that access to dorm air conditioning alleviates some of the impact of ambient heat on student learning. Yet heat still hurts the performance of students with access to cooling at home. Our study, which is inclusive of routine human behavior, suggests either a practical limit to adaptation or that adaptation can go further. We find larger heat impacts among students from temperate nations pursuing their undergraduate studies at this Asian educational hub, pointing to some scope for acclimatization. Whether through physiology or behavior, male learners are more vulnerable to heat than females.
articles.abstract_cn: 富裕的城市国家新加坡已投入巨资以适应其当前的热带气候。我们获取了该国一所顶尖大学在2005年至2019年间所有学生层面的本科课程记录，发现即使在这里，气温波动也会影响人力资本形成。样本内从最凉爽到最炎热学期的去季节化天气变化会使学期表现降低1.5%。利用准随机变异，我们发现证据表明，宿舍空调的接入缓解了环境高温对学生学习的一些影响。然而，对于家中拥有降温设备的学生，高温仍然损害其表现。我们的研究涵盖了日常行为，表明要么适应存在实际限制，要么适应可以进一步推进。我们发现，在这所亚洲教育中心攻读本科学位的温带国家学生受到的高温影响更大，这指向了适应环境的一定空间。无论是通过生理还是行为，男性学习者比女性更容易受到高温的影响。

articles.title_en: Just saying sorry—The effect of apologies on reintegration after social exclusion
articles.title_cn: 仅仅说声对不起——道歉对社会排斥后重新融入的影响
articles.abstract_en: Apologies are ubiquitous in life and across cultures and countries, and they are able to impact social relationships as well as material outcomes. One specific application refers to restorative justice and mediation programs. While empirical data is biased by unobservable influences, a controlled experiment provides additional evidence on the effect of apologies after exclusion. We present an experiment in which participants can steal from other group members and can be excluded for one period. We compare four treatments in which we give the option to apologize (or not) and where apologies can be tracked (or not). We find that apologizing significantly reduces theft and participants who apologize experience more re-integrative behavior from the rest of the group members than those who do not apologize. Additionally, we find that people do apologize even when their apologies cannot be tracked, suggesting that apologies are not purely used as a strategic device.
articles.abstract_cn: 道歉在生活以及不同文化和国家中无处不在，它们能够影响社会关系以及物质结果。一个具体的应用涉及恢复性司法和调解项目。虽然经验数据受到不可观察因素的影响，但一项受控实验为排斥后道歉的效果提供了额外证据。我们展示了一个实验，其中参与者可以从其他群体成员那里偷窃，并可能被排斥一个时期。我们比较了四种处理方式，在这些方式中，我们给予道歉（或不道歉）的选择，并且道歉可以被追踪（或不可追踪）。我们发现，道歉显著减少了偷窃行为，并且道歉的参与者比不道歉的参与者从其他群体成员那里体验到更多的重新融入行为。此外，我们发现即使道歉无法被追踪，人们也会道歉，这表明道歉并非纯粹作为策略性工具使用。

articles.title_en: Searching for the external validity of social preference games: A guide of field environments based on expert perceptions
articles.title_cn: 寻找社会偏好博弈的外部有效性：基于专家感知的实地环境指南
articles.abstract_en: The last couple of decades have witnessed a lively debate on the external validity of social preference games. Yet, scientific progress in this area has been restrained by the difficulty of delineating the field environments that social preference games should generalize to. Here we present three studies investigating the field environments and behaviors to which social preference games are expected to relate, according to specialist researchers. In Study 1, we systematically reviewed all the papers published in the top 5 economics journals that used social preference games, and we analyzed the field settings explicitly linked to the games by the authors. In Study 2, we used large language models to expand our analysis of the literature beyond the top 5. In Study 3, we conducted a survey among members of the Economic Science Association (ESA) mailing list to investigate the field environments they viewed as most closely associated with different social preference games. Overall, our results provide a rich guide to the types of field settings that are expected to relate to social preference games, according to the people who use them. This guide constitutes a useful reference to organize future research on external validity and make it more systematic.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去几十年中，关于社会偏好博弈外部有效性的争论一直很激烈。然而，由于难以界定社会偏好博弈应推广到的实地环境，该领域的科学进展受到了限制。在此，我们呈现了三项研究，探讨了根据专家研究者的看法，社会偏好博弈预期与哪些实地环境和行为相关。在研究1中，我们系统回顾了在顶级5本经济学期刊上发表的所有使用社会偏好博弈的论文，并分析了作者明确将博弈与之关联的实地设置。在研究2中，我们使用大型语言模型将文献分析扩展到顶级5本期刊之外。在研究三中，我们对经济科学协会（ESA）邮件列表成员进行了一项调查，以探讨他们认为与不同社会偏好博弈最密切相关的实地环境。总体而言，我们的结果提供了一个丰富的指南，说明了根据使用者的预期，社会偏好博弈应与哪些类型的实地设置相关。该指南为组织未来关于外部有效性的研究并使其更加系统化提供了有用的参考。

articles.title_en: A one way ticket to gig?
articles.title_cn: 通往零工经济的一张单程票？
articles.abstract_en: We propose a search and matching model to explore the labor market implications of a growing gig economy. The economy has conventional and gig sectors, with workers searching in both. Some workers never consider gig employment, and others do under certain conditions. Workers are allowed to work in both sectors at the same time if they prefer. Workers match with gig positions with probability one, but gig workers face a wage penalty and matching frictions in the conventional sector. As a result, gig work serves as an alternative to unemployment, the gig sector absorbs labor market slack from the conventional sector, but the choice to engage in the gig economy comes at a cost to workers. By comparing the implications of the model under various levels of exposure to the gig economy, we explore the nature of the sector and the opportunities and consequences that come with it. The benchmark model provides insights into the rise of the gig economy, highlighting its impact on workers and the segmentation of the labor markets. While the presence of the gig sector opens up new job opportunities, potential welfare implications from the existence of the gig sector and its frictions are estimated to range from a benefit around 80% to a cost of around 20%, and directly impact up to two-thirds of the workforce relative to a standard search model with no gig sector. The costs mostly apply to workers with middle to lower productivity, and therefore have important distributional implications. Promoting a more inclusive gig economy can enable market systems to address labor market challenges while preserving their innovative and adaptive capabilities. As a case study, the gig economy highlights the balance between market efficiency and social equity, providing valuable perspectives on labor relations, creative destruction, and policy solutions grounded in market economics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个搜索与匹配模型，以探讨日益增长的零工经济对劳动力市场的影响。经济中包含传统部门和零工部门，工人在两个部门中搜索工作。一些工人从不考虑零工就业，而另一些则在特定条件下会考虑。如果工人愿意，他们可以同时在两个部门工作。工人与零工岗位匹配的概率为一，但零工工人面临工资惩罚和传统部门的匹配摩擦。因此，零工工作成为失业的替代选择，零工部门吸收了传统部门的劳动力市场松弛，但参与零工经济的选择对工人而言是有代价的。通过比较模型在不同零工经济暴露水平下的含义，我们探讨了该部门的性质以及随之而来的机会和后果。基准模型为零工经济的兴起提供了见解，强调了其对工人的影响和劳动力市场的分割。虽然零工部门的存在开辟了新的就业机会，但零工部门及其摩擦可能带来的福利影响估计在约80%的收益到约20%的成本之间，并且相对于没有零工部门的标准搜索模型，直接影响多达三分之二的劳动力。成本主要适用于中低生产率的工人，因此具有重要的分配含义。促进更具包容性的零工经济可以使市场体系在保持其创新和适应能力的同时应对劳动力市场挑战。作为案例研究，零工经济凸显了市场效率与社会公平之间的平衡，为劳动关系、创造性破坏以及基于市场经济的政策解决方案提供了宝贵的视角。

articles.title_en: Damaging conflict: All-pay auctions with negative spillovers and bimodal bidding
articles.title_cn: 破坏性冲突：具有负外部性和双峰出价的全支付拍卖
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how the presence of a negative externality in an all-pay auction influences bidding behavior in the laboratory. In the standard risk-neutral model, Nash equilibrium predicts no difference in strategies between treatments with and without the externality. Our experimental results provide some support for this prediction, as average bids do not differ significantly across treatments and generally align with equilibrium benchmarks. However, bidding distributions in both treatments exhibit a pronounced bimodal pattern that is consistent with previous all-pay auction experiments but inconsistent with risk-neutral Nash predictions. To account for these features, we evaluate two models of bounded rationality, incorporating prospect theory-inspired preferences: quantal response equilibrium (QRE) and a variant on noisy introspection that we call Belief-Perturbed Logit (BPL). While both models can rationalize bimodal bidding, QRE provides the superior fit while also predicting the location of bid peaks across treatments. These results reinforce the growing evidence that while subjects may not mix strategies exactly as prescribed by Nash equilibrium, their bidding behavior remains broadly equilibrium-consistent. Our findings also support the role of reference dependence and loss aversion in explaining bimodal bidding and strategic behavior more generally.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在全支付拍卖中负外部性的存在如何影响实验室中的出价行为。在标准风险中性模型中，纳什均衡预测有无外部性的处理组之间策略没有差异。我们的实验结果在一定程度上支持了这一预测，因为平均出价在各处理组之间没有显著差异，并且总体上与均衡基准一致。然而，两种处理中的出价分布都表现出明显的双峰模式，这与之前的全支付拍卖实验一致，但与风险中性纳什预测不符。为了解释这些特征，我们评估了两种有限理性模型，结合了前景理论启发的偏好：量化响应均衡（QRE）和一种我们称为信念扰动Logit（BPL）的噪声内省变体。虽然两种模型都能合理化双峰出价，但QRE提供了更优的拟合，同时也预测了各处理组中出价峰值的位置。这些结果强化了越来越多的证据，即虽然受试者可能不会完全按照纳什均衡的规定混合策略，但他们的出价行为仍然大致与均衡一致。我们的发现也支持参考依赖和损失厌恶在解释双峰出价及更普遍的战略行为中的作用。

articles.title_en: The fiscal effects of political tenure
articles.title_cn: 政治任期制的财政效应
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how the tenure of ruling parties and coalitions shapes government spending through intra-governmental negotiations. We assemble a comprehensive dataset covering four decades and including both established and emerging democracies to develop a novel measure of accumulated tenure in office for ruling parties or coalitions since the establishment of democracy. Our measure reveals substantial variation in the political tenure of rulers who alternate in office and identifies a significant fiscal effect of political tenure. A ten percent increase in tenure raises government expenditure, measured as a percentage of GDP, by 0.23 percentage points and the deficit by 0.21 percentage points over 1972–2014. We outline a conceptual framework that accounts for the uncovered empirical relationship and suggest the relevance of a fading “honeymoon effect”, which revisits Olson’s argument on the dynamic effects of distributional coalitions. The older the ruling group, the more divisive the remaining policies to be implemented, which requires costly transfers in the form of public expenditure to maintain cohesion within the ruling group. Our findings contribute to the understanding of bargaining in democratic settings, showing how political negotiation shapes fiscal policy and the distribution of resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了执政党和执政联盟的任期如何通过政府内部谈判影响政府支出。我们汇编了一个涵盖四十年、包括既有民主国家和新兴民主国家的全面数据集，以开发一种新的衡量标准，即自民主建立以来执政党或联盟在任累计时间。我们的衡量标准揭示了轮流执政的统治者政治任期的显著差异，并识别出政治任期对财政的显著影响。任期每增加百分之十，政府支出（占GDP的百分比）将增加0.23个百分点，赤字将增加0.21个百分点，时间跨度为1972-2014。我们概述了一个概念框架来解释所发现的实证关系，并提出了“蜜月效应”逐渐消退的相关性，这重新审视了奥尔森关于分配联盟动态效应的论点。执政集团越老，待实施的政策分歧越大，这需要以公共支出形式进行昂贵的转移支付以维持执政集团内部的凝聚力。我们的发现有助于理解民主环境中的谈判，展示了政治谈判如何塑造财政政策和资源分配。

articles.title_en: The cross section of stock returns in an artificial stock market
articles.title_cn: 人工股票市场中的股票收益横截面
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop an Artificial Stock Market (ASM) - an agent-based simulation model of the stock market. We present the model and demonstrate its ability to replicate the main empirical features of equity markets. Our model can generate the stylized facts in the time-series domain such as the random walk property, long memory, excess volatility, negative skewness, and excess kurtosis. In the cross-section of stocks, the model generates excess co-movement as well as factor premia as in real-life equity markets. A well-defined ASM can generate large amounts of data, and function as a laboratory. Hence, it can be a complementary methodological approach to research in financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们开发了一个人工股票市场（ASM）——一个基于代理的股票市场模拟模型。我们展示了该模型，并证明了其复制股票市场主要经验特征的能力。我们的模型能够生成时间序列领域的典型事实，如随机游走性质、长记忆性、过度波动性、负偏度和过度峰度。在股票的横截面中，该模型生成了过度共动以及因子溢价，如同现实股票市场中的情况。一个定义良好的ASM可以生成大量数据，并充当实验室。因此，它可以作为金融市场研究的一种补充方法论途径。

articles.title_en: Expectations-based reference-dependence and labor supply: Eliciting cabdrivers’ expectations in the field
articles.title_cn: 基于期望的参照依赖与劳动供给：在实地中引出出租车司机的期望
articles.abstract_en: This paper reports a field experiment on Shanghai cabdrivers’ labor supply, analyzing the data using an expectations-based reference-dependent model that allows daily income- and hours-targeting. Our main innovation is to elicit the cabdrivers’ income and hours expectations, twice a day. We find that expectations indeed affect labor supply in a way predicted by a reference-dependent model, and hours expectations have a stronger influence than income expectations. Both expectations are found to be correlated with their most recent historical average values. While income expectations do adjust within the day, hours expectations are sticky. The findings suggest that the targeting effect based on hours expectations plays a more important role than traditionally thought.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文报告了一项关于上海出租车司机劳动供给的实地实验，并使用允许每日收入和时间目标的基于期望的参照依赖模型分析数据。我们的主要创新在于每天两次引出出租车司机的收入和时间期望。我们发现，期望确实以参照依赖模型预测的方式影响劳动供给，且时间期望的影响强于收入期望。两种期望均与其最近的历史平均值相关。虽然收入期望在一天内会调整，但时间期望则具有粘性。研究结果表明，基于时间期望的目标效应比传统认为的更为重要。

articles.title_en: Gender quotas and politicians’ education
articles.title_cn: 性别配额与政治家的教育水平
articles.abstract_en: What are the effects of gender quotas on the educational attainment of municipality councils? While extensive research examines the political consequences of gender quotas, their impact on the educational qualifications of elected officials remains unclear. This paper provides novel evidence from Spain, analyzing 119,624 elected municipal councilors across the 2003, 2007, 2011, and 2015 elections. Using a difference-in-discontinuities research design, we compare outcomes before and after quota implementation in municipalities below and above the population threshold for quota enforcement. Our results show that, on average, gender quotas have no significant effect on the educational composition of elected male and female councilors. Thus, while quotas successfully increase female representation, they appear neutral regarding the overall education levels of elected politicians. However, further analyses reveal that quotas increase the average education level of elected politicians in municipalities with initially lower education levels, but decrease it in those with higher pre-quota education levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 性别配额对市议会教育程度有何影响？尽管大量研究探讨了性别配额的政治后果，但其对当选官员教育资格的影响仍不明确。本文提供了来自西班牙的新证据，分析了2003、2007、2011和2015年选举中当选的119,624名市政议员。利用断点回归不连续设计，我们比较了配额实施前后，在配额执行人口阈值以下和以上的城市中的结果。我们的结果显示，平均而言，性别配额对当选男性和女性议员的教育构成没有显著影响。因此，虽然配额成功提高了女性代表性，但就当选政治家的整体教育水平而言，它们似乎是中性的。然而，进一步分析显示，在初始教育水平较低的城市中，配额提高了当选政治家的平均教育水平，但在配额前教育水平较高的城市中则降低了这一水平。

articles.title_en: Highways to prosperity: Unlocking their potential through anti-poverty interventions
articles.title_cn: 通往繁荣的高速公路：通过反贫困干预释放其潜力
articles.abstract_en: How do investments in infrastructure, largely government-funded, interact with other major public investments? We explore the interaction between two coincident yet uncoordinated national programs in China: the latest highway program leading to counties’ quick and staggered highway connections and anti-poverty program implementing interventions in beneficiary counties. We compile new county-year-level highway network data and couple them with multiple datasets. Using a generalized difference-in-differences design, we exploit the quasi-experimental variation generated by the staggered rollout of connections. New highways alone have negative or limited effects on local incomes. However, counties with access to both highways and interventions experience substantial income gains, with total household income increasing by nine percent and per capita income by six percent. The impact persists over a six-year period. Evidence supports mechanisms that households are more likely to be employed, shift to non-agricultural work, improve labor mobility, develop family industries, and adopt modern agricultural technologies and cash crops.
articles.abstract_cn: 基础设施投资，主要由政府资助，如何与其他重大公共投资相互作用？我们探讨了中国两个同时发生但未协调的国家计划之间的相互作用：最新的高速公路计划导致各县快速且交错地接入高速公路，以及反贫困计划在受益县实施干预措施。我们编制了新的县级年度高速公路网络数据，并将其与多个数据集相结合。采用广义双重差分设计，我们利用了由交错接入产生的准实验变异。仅新建高速公路对当地收入有负面或有限的影响。然而，同时获得高速公路和干预措施的县经历了显著的收入增长，家庭总收入增加了百分之九，人均收入增加了百分之六。这种影响持续了六年。证据支持这样的机制：家庭更有可能就业，转向非农工作，提高劳动力流动性，发展家庭产业，并采用现代农业技术和经济作物。

articles.title_en: Cooperation in multiplayer dilemmas
articles.title_cn: 多人困境中的合作
articles.abstract_en: We analyze infinitely repeated multiplayer prisoner’s dilemmas in continuous-time experiments. As the number of players changes, our design keeps the payoffs of the all-defection, all-cooperation, and unilateral defection and cooperation outcomes constant, thus controlling for the minimum discount factor required for cooperation to be an equilibrium. For all group sizes, we study three different variants of the prisoner’s dilemma. In further treatments, we allow actions to be chosen from a continuous set. We find that cooperation rates decrease with the number of players, a result that we can attribute to the increased strategic uncertainty in larger groups. The different payoff matrices also affect cooperation. For the payoff matrices with lower levels of cooperation, the group-size effect is weaker. The availability of a continuous action set strongly reduces cooperation rates.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在连续时间实验中分析了无限重复的多人囚徒困境。随着参与者数量的变化，我们的设计保持全背叛、全合作以及单方面背叛和合作结果的收益不变，从而控制了合作成为均衡所需的最低贴现因子。对于所有群体规模，我们研究了囚徒困境的三种不同变体。在进一步的处理中，我们允许从连续集合中选择行动。我们发现合作率随着参与者数量的增加而下降，这一结果可归因于更大群体中战略不确定性的增加。不同的收益矩阵也影响合作。对于合作水平较低的收益矩阵，群体规模效应较弱。连续行动集的可用性显著降低了合作率。

articles.title_en: The unequal effect of pandemics on aging and longevity: A health economic analysis
articles.title_cn: 流行病对老龄化和寿命的不平等影响：一项健康经济分析
articles.abstract_en: We propose a health economic model to examine the short- and long-term effects of the Covid-19 pandemic on individual aging and longevity, conditional on attitudes towards protection, initial health status, age at the onset of the pandemic, and individual misconceptions about the consequences of infections. Moreover, we explore the individual-specific effects of Long Covid on long-term health outcomes. Individuals invest in their health to slow down health deficit accumulation and take measures to protect themselves from infectious diseases. The model captures how the severity of Covid-19 infections depends on the frailty (pre-existing conditions) of infected individuals and how infections contribute to the accumulation of chronic health deficits and mortality risk from non-communicable diseases. We calibrate the model for an average American. In addition to understanding the unequal health effects of the Covid-19 pandemic, we also contribute to understanding health inequality in general.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个健康经济模型，以考察Covid-19大流行对个体老龄化和寿命的短期与长期影响，这些影响取决于对保护的态度、初始健康状况、大流行开始时的年龄以及个体对感染后果的误解。此外，我们探讨了长新冠对长期健康结果的个体特定影响。个体投资于自身健康以减缓健康缺陷的积累，并采取措施保护自己免受传染病侵害。该模型捕捉了Covid-19感染的严重程度如何取决于感染者的脆弱性（既有疾病），以及感染如何促进慢性健康缺陷的积累和非传染性疾病死亡风险的增加。我们针对一个普通美国人校准了该模型。除了理解Covid-19大流行的不平等健康影响外，我们还为理解总体健康不平等做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: How green credit policies drive green innovation: evidence from a natural experiment in China
articles.title_cn: 绿色信贷政策如何驱动绿色创新：来自中国自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of Green Credit Guidelines (GCG) on green innovation, with a particular focus on heavily polluting firms. Using panel data of Chinese A-share listed firms, the findings reveal a nuanced effect: while green credit policies increased green patent applications by 18.28 % for environmental protection firms, they significantly reduced green patent output among heavily polluting firms, including a 8.11 % decline in green patents. Further heterogeneity analysis shows that the inhibitory effects are more pronounced among private firms and those operating in high-competition industries. Mechanism analysis indicates that this decline is primarily driven by a conservative strategy, where polluting firms, perceiving their disadvantaged status in green credit assessments, reduce R&D investments. This mechanism accounts for 21 % of the total effects. These findings underscore the unintended consequences of green credit policies and highlight the need for tailored frameworks that balance environmental protection goals with the promotion of innovation across diverse firm types. Policymakers should consider targeted support for heavily polluting firms to facilitate their transition to green technologies and mitigate financing constraints, ensuring the dual objectives of environmental sustainability and innovation are achieved effectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了《绿色信贷指引》（GCG）对绿色创新的影响，特别关注重污染企业。利用中国A股上市公司的面板数据，研究结果揭示了一种微妙的影响：虽然绿色信贷政策使环保企业的绿色专利申请增加了18.28%，但显著减少了重污染企业的绿色专利产出，其中包括绿色专利下降8.11%。进一步的异质性分析显示，这种抑制作用在私营企业和处于高竞争行业的企业中更为明显。机制分析表明，这种下降主要由保守策略驱动，即污染企业感知到其在绿色信贷评估中的不利地位，从而减少研发投资。该机制占总效应的21%。这些发现强调了绿色信贷政策的意外后果，并凸显了制定平衡环境保护目标与促进不同类型企业创新的定制框架的必要性。政策制定者应考虑对重污染企业提供有针对性的支持，以促进其向绿色技术转型并缓解融资约束，确保环境可持续性和创新的双重目标得到有效实现。

articles.title_en: Nash solutions for bargaining problems with a reference point
articles.title_cn: 具有参考点的讨价还价问题的纳什解
articles.abstract_en: We explore the implications of the presence of a reference point on bargaining outcomes. We consider Nash’s four original axioms with two additional axioms making use of the reference point: equal direction of changes and invariance with respect to the Shalev transformation (Shalev invariance). Because any solution that satisfies Pareto efficiency, scale invariance, contraction independence, and the two new axioms must be independent of the disagreement point when the reference point is feasible, we propose two notions of symmetry and derive two different solutions: the constrained Nash bargaining solution and the r-Nash bargaining solution. In addition to our main results, we include an axiomatic characterization of the disagreement solution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了参考点的存在对讨价还价结果的影响。我们考虑纳什的四个原始公理，并添加两个利用参考点的额外公理：变化的等方向性和对沙列夫变换的不变性（沙列夫不变性）。因为任何满足帕累托效率、尺度不变性、收缩独立性和这两个新公理的解，在参考点可行时，必须独立于分歧点，我们提出了两种对称性概念，并推导出两个不同的解：约束纳什讨价还价解和r-纳什讨价还价解。除了我们的主要结果外，我们还包含了分歧解的公理化刻画。

articles.title_en: Supply expansion of Long-Term Services & Supports: Evidence from China’s long-term care insurance pilot
articles.title_cn: 长期照护服务与支持的供给扩张：来自中国长期护理保险试点的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates how public long-term care insurance (LTCI) fosters market expansion in the Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) industry. Using a Difference-in-Differences regression approach and leveraging China’s business administrative data, we observe an increase of 10 firms entering markets where the LTCI pilot policy is implemented. We develop a structural model of an entry game incorporating discrete location choices to analyze entrants’ strategic behaviors. Our structural estimates indicate a high barrier to entry in the LTSS industry. However, China’s LTCI pilot program offers substantial profitability incentives, equivalent to approximately 41% of the entry costs, effectively motivating market entry. Our robustness checks confirm LTCI’s consistent positive effect on market entry and highlight high entry costs as a key barrier. Counterfactual simulations show that nationwide LTCI implementation and a lower entry barrier would significantly expand the LTSS market, with geographically targeted policies – especially income equalization and localized incentives – being effective in enhancing regional development. These findings highlight the critical role of public policy in stimulating the development of the LTSS sector as global demand increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨公共长期护理保险（LTCI）如何促进长期照护服务与支持（LTSS）行业的市场扩张。采用双重差分回归方法，并利用中国的工商管理数据，我们观察到在实施LTCI试点政策的市场中，企业进入数量增加了10家。我们开发了一个包含离散区位选择的进入博弈结构模型，以分析进入者的战略行为。结构估计表明，LTSS行业存在较高的进入壁垒。然而，中国的LTCI试点项目提供了可观的盈利激励，相当于进入成本的约41%，有效激励了市场进入。稳健性检验证实了LTCI对市场进入的一致正向效应，并强调高进入成本是主要障碍。反事实模拟显示，全国范围内的LTCI实施和较低的进入壁垒将显著扩大LTSS市场，而地理定向政策——尤其是收入均等化和地方激励——在促进区域发展方面效果显著。这些发现凸显了公共政策在刺激LTSS部门发展中的关键作用，尤其是在全球需求增长的背景下。

articles.title_en: Inflation concern, attention and central bank trust
articles.title_cn: 通胀担忧、关注度与中央银行信任
articles.abstract_en: Using individual-level data on trust in the European Central Bank, we study the association between inflation and the public’s trust in the ECB. We find that inflation concern is important for understanding the link between inflation and central bank trust. Inflation is not directly linked to the public trust in the ECB but rather associated to it indirectly when it becomes a concern for survey respondents. We show that the public’s inflation concern, although related to inflation attention, is only partly explained by it and is also a function of realized inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用关于欧洲中央银行信任度的个体层面数据，我们研究了通胀与公众对欧洲央行信任度之间的关联。我们发现，通胀担忧对于理解通胀与中央银行信任之间的联系至关重要。通胀并不直接与公众对欧洲央行的信任相关，而是当通胀成为调查受访者的担忧事项时，才间接与之相关联。我们表明，公众的通胀担忧虽然与通胀关注度相关，但仅部分由其解释，同时也是实际通胀的函数。

articles.title_en: Costly information intermediation: Quality vs. Spillovers
articles.title_cn: 昂贵的信息中介：质量与溢出
articles.abstract_en: We analyze information intermediaries in large economies with costly information acquisition. Intermediaries face a trade-off between quality and dissemination speed. Both altruistic policymakers and profit-maximizing monopolists optimally choose to sample limited information, increasing the number of partially informed agents and enhancing spillovers despite slower information accumulation. Altruistic information-sharing bureaus minimize fees by inducing low provider default rates, while monopolist bureaus maximize fees through higher faulty service rates. Information trade resembles a natural monopoly, where competition reduces efficiency through redundant costs and lower information spillovers. These findings inform regulatory design in platforms and information-intensive markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在信息获取成本高昂的大型经济中的信息中介。中介机构面临质量与传播速度之间的权衡。利他主义政策制定者和利润最大化的垄断者都最优地选择抽样有限的信息，增加部分知情代理人的数量，并增强溢出效应，尽管信息积累速度较慢。利他主义的信息共享机构通过诱导较低的提供者违约率来最小化费用，而垄断机构则通过更高的故障服务率来最大化费用。信息贸易类似于自然垄断，其中竞争通过冗余成本和较低的信息溢出降低效率。这些发现为平台和信息密集型市场的监管设计提供了信息。

articles.title_en: Status incentive and peer spillover effects on physical activity habits
articles.title_cn: 地位激励与同伴溢出效应对体育锻炼习惯的影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of status-based threshold incentives on physical activity habits using a longitudinal data set from a private health and life insurance provider in the United Kingdom. We find that status-based incentives effectively foster sustained behavioral change, persisting even after the incentive is removed. We find variations in responses based on status goal levels and peer influence within member group sets. These findings suggest that status-driven incentives are particularly effective among individuals with weaker pre-existing habits, reinforcing the importance of social comparisons and goal gradient effects in shaping behavior. Our results contribute to the broader literature on threshold incentives, habit formation, and peer spillover effects in physical activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自英国一家私人健康和寿险提供商的纵向数据集，考察了基于地位的门槛激励对体育锻炼习惯的影响。我们发现，基于地位的激励能有效促进持续的行为改变，即使在激励取消后这种改变仍然存在。我们根据地位目标水平和成员组内的同伴影响发现了反应差异。这些发现表明，地位驱动的激励在原有习惯较弱的个体中尤为有效，强化了社会比较和目标梯度效应在塑造行为中的重要性。我们的结果对关于体育锻炼中门槛激励、习惯形成和同伴溢出效应的更广泛文献有所贡献。

articles.title_en: Taking the green pill: Macroeconomic and financial risks of the energy transition in the MATRIX model
articles.title_cn: 服用绿色药丸：MATRIX模型中能源转型的宏观经济与金融风险
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the macro-financial risks of the energy transition using an extended MATRIX model, a multi-agent, multi-sector integrated assessment framework for the Euro Area. The model features endogenous, directed technical change in the energy sector and a decentralized electricity market operating under a merit-order rule. Energy firms switch technologies based on relative profitability, creating feedback loops between R&D, productivity, and competitiveness, that can lead to either a brown lock-in or a green energy transition. We compare conventional environmental policies, such as a brown tax on polluting firms’ profits, a carbon tax on emissions, and green subsidies — both unconditional and R&D-based — with alternative policy mixes, including coordinated monetary policy, green finance, and green industrial policy. Results show that conventional policies modestly increase the likelihood of a green transition, but entail significant GDP losses due to production and financial constraints. Green finance and industrial policy mitigate these costs by easing sectoral bottlenecks and fostering a more effective transition. Finally, the brown tax proves more effective than carbon tax, as polluting firms tend to pass carbon costs onto consumers, reducing its impact.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用扩展的MATRIX模型（一个针对欧元区的多主体、多部门综合评估框架）研究能源转型的宏观金融风险。该模型以能源部门内生、定向的技术变革和基于优先次序规则运行的分散化电力市场为特征。能源企业根据相对盈利能力切换技术，在研发、生产率和竞争力之间形成反馈循环，这可能导致棕色锁定或绿色能源转型。我们将常规环境政策，如对污染企业利润征收棕色税、对排放征收碳税以及绿色补贴（包括无条件补贴和基于研发的补贴），与替代性政策组合（包括协调货币政策、绿色金融和绿色产业政策）进行比较。结果表明，常规政策适度增加了绿色转型的可能性，但由于生产和金融约束，会带来显著的GDP损失。绿色金融和产业政策通过缓解部门瓶颈和促进更有效的转型来减轻这些成本。最后，棕色税被证明比碳税更有效，因为污染企业倾向于将碳成本转嫁给消费者，从而削弱了碳税的影响。

articles.title_en: Known unknowns in closing firms and the earnings losses of laid off workers and early leavers
articles.title_cn: 关闭企业中的已知未知与下岗工人及提前离职者的收入损失
articles.abstract_en: We leverage a rare feature of the Canadian Employment Insurance system, which requires all employers to provide a detailed reason for every job separation that occurs in their firm, to distinguish between the earnings losses of workers permanently laid off from a closing firm and those of a broader category of workers often presumed to be affected by an impending firm closure. We highlight the role of assumptions about workers’ awareness of the impending closure and argue that a single set of assumptions imposed on all firms is unlikely to yield a meaningful estimate of the average earnings loss. Instead, we consider a range of estimates bounded by two key scenarios. Compared with tightly matched controls, the earnings losses of displaced workers range from 15.2% to 34.6% in the first post-closure year and from 7.6% to 15.0% in the fifth year. The lower bound is heavily influenced by those who leave the closing firm for reasons other than a permanent layoff.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用加拿大就业保险系统的一个罕见特征，该系统要求所有雇主为其企业内发生的每一次工作分离提供详细原因，以区分从关闭企业中被永久解雇的工人与那些通常被认为受即将到来的企业关闭影响的更广泛类别工人的收入损失。我们强调了关于工人对即将关闭的认知假设的作用，并认为对所有企业施加单一假设集不太可能产生有意义的平均收入损失估计。相反，我们考虑了一系列由两个关键情景界定的估计。与严格匹配的对照组相比，被解雇工人在关闭后第一年的收入损失范围为15.2%至34.6%，第五年为7.6%至15.0%。下界受到那些因永久解雇以外原因离开关闭企业的人的严重影响。

articles.title_en: Once upon a loan: How folk tales shape access to credit
articles.title_cn: 贷款童话：民间故事如何影响信贷获取
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of folklore on firms’ access to credit. Using firm-level data on a large sample of 38,000 firms covering 124 countries and 274 cultural societies over the 2005–2022 period, we test the hypothesis that oral traditions linking risk-taking to success or failure influence access to credit. We find that folklore affects access to credit. Oral traditions associated with successful challenges increase access to credit, while those associated with unsuccessful challenges decrease access to credit. We further show that folklore influences access to credit through borrower discouragement and loan approval. We also find that foreign-owned firms are less sensitive to the influence of folklore, while more developed legal institutions reinforce its impact. We further observe that folklore explains aggregate credit supply at the country level. Using representations of trust in folklore, we find that more trusting societies are associated with more loan approval but lower loan applications, which results from the fact that higher trust encourages informal credit.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了民间传说对企业信贷获取的影响。利用覆盖124个国家、274个文化社会、时间跨度为2005-2022年的大型样本中38,000家企业的微观数据，我们检验了将冒险与成功或失败联系起来的口头传统是否影响信贷获取的假设。我们发现民间传说确实影响信贷获取。与成功挑战相关的口头传统增加了信贷获取，而与失败挑战相关的口头传统减少了信贷获取。我们进一步表明，民间传说通过借款人沮丧情绪和贷款审批影响信贷获取。我们还发现，外资企业对民间传说的影响较不敏感，而更发达的法律制度则强化了其影响。我们进一步观察到，民间传说在国家层面解释了总体信贷供给。利用民间传说中的信任表征，我们发现更信任的社会与更多的贷款审批但更少的贷款申请相关，这是因为更高的信任鼓励了非正式信贷。

articles.title_en: The impacts of return policies and perception heterogeneity on sales platforms for experience goods: An experimental study
articles.title_cn: 退货政策与感知异质性对体验品销售平台的影响：一项实验研究
articles.abstract_en: On sales platforms for experience goods, consumers only know the distribution of a good’s value before purchase, while its actual value is revealed after the purchase. However, consumers may perceive the distribution’s range differently, and the presence of a return policy can also influence strategic interactions in the market. Utilizing a post-price framework and controlled laboratory experiments, this paper provides the first investigation of experience goods markets that directly examines (1) the presence of a return policy and (2) the level of consumers’ perception heterogeneity about the range of the value’s corresponding distribution. We find that return policies result in lower prices in markets for experience goods. In addition, a larger perception heterogeneity reduces prices and increases return rates. Our results highlight potential downsides of mandated return policies on online sales platforms, as they reduce sellers’ profits without improving consumer welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 在体验品销售平台上，消费者在购买前仅知道商品价值的分布，而实际价值在购买后才揭示。然而，消费者对分布范围的感知可能不同，退货政策的存在也可能影响市场中的策略互动。利用定价后框架和受控实验室实验，本文首次对体验品市场进行了调查，直接检验了（1）退货政策的存在和（2）消费者对价值对应分布范围的感知异质性水平。我们发现，退货政策导致体验品市场的价格降低。此外，更大的感知异质性降低了价格并提高了退货率。我们的结果强调了在线销售平台上强制退货政策的潜在弊端，因为它们降低了卖家利润而未改善消费者福利。

articles.title_en: Social norms in survey experiments: Personal beliefs versus normative expectations
articles.title_cn: 调查实验中的社会规范：个人信念与规范性期望
articles.abstract_en: In Experimental Economics, coordination games are used to elicit social norms as incentivized beliefs about others’ beliefs (Normative Expectations). Conversely, representative surveys, such as the World Values Survey, elicit social norms as Personal Beliefs that are independent of others’ beliefs. We design a survey experiment based on a representative sample of the Italian population (N=1,501) to compare these two measures of social norms, with attitudes toward gender roles as a working example. We obtain the following results. At the aggregate level, agreement ratings from the two measures follow a similar pattern but differ significantly in magnitude, with norms based on Personal Beliefs depicting a more progressive view of gender roles. The individual-level analysis accounts for this result: most respondents report Personal Beliefs that are more progressive than their perceptions of others’ beliefs, regardless of the accuracy of those perceptions. This behavior is positively associated with holding a university degree and may reflect genuinely progressive views, a bias toward appearing progressive, or an ongoing shift in social norms. Finally, we compare the explanatory power of the two measures of social norms in analyzing a set of women’s labor market outcomes, showing that Normative Expectations outperform Personal Beliefs when the norm is “strong.”
articles.abstract_cn: 在实验经济学中，协调博弈被用来引出社会规范，作为对他人信念的激励性信念（规范性期望）。相反，代表性调查，如世界价值观调查，将社会规范引出为独立于他人信念的个人信念。我们设计了一项基于意大利人口代表性样本（N=1,501）的调查实验，以比较这两种社会规范测量方式，并以对性别角色的态度作为工作示例。我们获得以下结果。在总体层面，两种测量方式的同意评分遵循相似模式，但在幅度上存在显著差异，基于个人信念的规范描绘了更进步的性别角色观点。个体层面分析解释了这一结果：大多数受访者报告的个人信念比他们对他人信念的感知更为进步，无论这些感知是否准确。这种行为与拥有大学学位正相关，可能反映了真正进步的观点、倾向于表现进步，或社会规范正在发生的转变。最后，我们比较了这两种社会规范测量在分析一组女性劳动力市场结果时的解释力，表明当规范“强”时，规范性期望优于个人信念。

articles.title_en: Performance pay and job quits
articles.title_cn: 绩效工资与员工离职
articles.abstract_en: We use US longitudinal survey data to examine the role of performance pay (other than profit sharing) in worker quit decisions. We argue that performance pay increasingly indicates an internal labor market rather than simply a contemporaneous incentive. Suggestive of this claim, we find that in ever more complete specifications that account for worker and employer characteristics, aggregate earnings, fringe benefits and worker job satisfaction, performance pay is associated with a reduced probability of worker quits. This association remains when including worker fixed effects to control for unmeasured invariant heterogeneity. We investigate how it varies with the type of performance pay and its intensity. We confirm heterogeneity in this association by workplace size.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用美国纵向调查数据来考察绩效工资（利润分享除外）在员工离职决策中的作用。我们认为，绩效工资日益表明内部劳动力市场的存在，而不仅仅是同期激励。支持这一观点的证据是，在越来越完整的规范中，控制了工人和雇主特征、总收益、附加福利和工人工作满意度后，我们发现绩效工资与工人离职概率降低相关。在加入工人固定效应以控制未观测到的时不变异质性后，这种关联仍然存在。我们研究了这种关联如何随绩效工资的类型及其强度而变化。我们确认了这种关联在工作场所规模上的异质性。

articles.title_en: The impact of economic adversity on adolescent self-esteem: Evidence from Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 经济逆境对青少年自尊的影响：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between self-esteem and random negative economic shocks experienced during the formative stages of the life cycle. Combining individual data from parents and children within the same household, with rainfall variation during the growing season in Ethiopia, we find that negative shocks experienced during adolescence have a relevant negative and persistent effect on self-esteem. Moreover, we find some tentative evidence that these shocks may have an effect that spans generations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了自尊与生命周期形成阶段经历的随机负面经济冲击之间的关系。结合同一家庭内父母和子女的个人数据，以及埃塞俄比亚生长季节的降雨量变化，我们发现青少年时期经历的负面冲击对自尊具有显著且持久的负面影响。此外，我们找到一些初步证据表明，这些冲击可能具有跨代影响。

articles.title_en: The indirect environmental effects of taxing waste
articles.title_cn: 垃圾征税的间接环境效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the indirect effects of environmental policies that target waste production, i.e., pay-as-you-throw (PAYT) schemes. Using a newly constructed longitudinal dataset of Italian municipalities and a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that PAYT adoption generates positive effects on pro-environmental behaviors not directly targeted by the policy (indirect effects), in addition to reducing unsorted waste production (direct effect). Survey evidence shows that PAYT increases the salience of environmental issues among treated residents, which in turn strengthens their pro-environmental attitudes. These findings suggest that narrowly targeted environmental policies can lead to broader behavioral changes by fostering environmental awareness.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了针对垃圾生产的环保政策（即按量收费计划）的间接效应。利用新构建的意大利市政纵向数据集和堆叠双重差分设计，我们发现，除了减少未分类垃圾生产（直接效应）外，采用按量收费计划还对政策未直接针对的亲环境行为产生了积极影响（间接效应）。调查证据显示，按量收费计划提高了受处理居民对环境问题的关注度，进而增强了他们的亲环境态度。这些发现表明，针对性强的环保政策可以通过培养环境意识引发更广泛的行为改变。

articles.title_en: Group identity and peer effects in rule-following
articles.title_cn: 群体身份与规则遵循中的同伴效应
articles.abstract_en: Social life is governed by a myriad of rules but the behavioral logic of why people follow rules is only incompletely understood. Here, we investigate how rule following is influenced by other people and social proximity to them. In particular, we are interested in the identity composition of an individual’s observed peer group: does it matter whether a rule breaker is an ingroup or an outgroup member? To investigate this question, we use a novel abstract rule-following task with strong incentives to break the rule. We call our rule-following task the “Y task” because the rule requested participants (n=7,033 Prolific workers) to take one of the two diverging paths of a Y-shaped maze. Consistent with previous research, we show that examples of rule violations trigger further rule violations, even though overall rule compliance remains high. Contrary to our hypotheses, and research on honesty and cooperation, we do not find that group identity moderates the influence of peer compliance on people’s willingness to follow rules. We conclude that rule breaking is contagious regardless of the ingroup or outgroup status of the rule breaker.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会生活受无数规则支配，但人们为何遵守规则的行为逻辑尚未被完全理解。在此，我们研究规则遵循如何受到他人及其社会亲近度的影响。特别地，我们关注个体所观察到的同伴群体的身份构成：违规者是内群体成员还是外群体成员是否重要？为探究此问题，我们采用了一项新颖的抽象规则遵循任务，该任务具有强烈的违规激励。我们将此规则遵循任务称为“Y任务”，因为规则要求参与者（n=7,033名Prolific工作者）在Y形迷宫的兩条分叉路径中选择一条。与先前研究一致，我们表明违规示例会引发进一步的违规行为，尽管总体规则遵从度仍然较高。与我们的假设以及关于诚实与合作的研究相反，我们未发现群体身份会调节同伴遵从对人们遵循规则意愿的影响。我们得出结论：无论违规者是内群体还是外群体成员，违规行为都具有传染性。
